title: Make streaming representation choices aware of complete-plan feasibility

definition.title: Make streaming representation choices aware of complete-plan feasibility
definition.source_excerpt: Streaming · New integration hypothesis · P2 · Risk: High First environment: Qualified streaming implementation required. Dependencies: R15. Status: Untested hypothesis. Proposed mechanism. Let the existing adaptive controller consider whether a rendition preserves a qualified browser-owned plan and requested HDR/audio/subtitles, not bandwidth alone. Invalidate only affected track/configuration state rather than rebuilding unrelated video or audio. Source basis. MSE supports configuration changes, while WebCodecs support is configuration-specific. These are primitives; neither supplies Demuxe’s adaptive policy. [M1, W1] First agent experiment. After the streaming baseline is qualified, use equivalent-role renditions with different codec/configuration requirements. Compare existing adaptation policy with compatibility-aware selection and per-track invalidation.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.initial_screen: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

prepare.basis: Required existing ABR/per-track transition implementation is absent; one-shot selector probe does not supply it.

screen.basis: Actual maintained HLS selector chooses highest bandwidth under cap, honors an explicit rendition even above cap, and rejects missing explicit IDs. It does not consult plan feasibility; StreamingOptions explicitly specifies one session rendition, not automatic bitrate switching. The source-required existing adaptive controller and qualified R015 per-track transactional switch are not available. This is a verified implementation/setup prerequisite blocker, not a negative experiment on the proposed policy.

correctness.basis: No complete-plan-aware adaptive transition candidate ran. The existing one-shot selector probe confirms boundary only; it cannot qualify HDR/audio/subtitle preservation, playback fidelity or track invalidation. Missing ABR owner and R015 transactional prerequisite remain explicit.
